_about: Hand-curated: the game files have no notion of 'missable'. Each entry pins to an existing marker (`at`) and is checked off by hand. Add `flag` (an event flag id) to have the save tick it automatically.

missables.name: Magic Scorpion Charm (Preceptor Seluvis)
missables.lockedBy: Seluvis is found dead once Ranni's quest reaches the Fingerslayer Blade. Get the charm from him before then.

missables.name: Gelmir's Fury (Bernahl's request)
missables.lockedBy: Defeating Rykard before finishing Bernahl's Volcano Manor request.

missables.name: Taker's Cameo (Volcano Manor, Juno Hoslow request)
missables.lockedBy: Defeating Rykard before completing the Volcano Manor requests, ending with Juno Hoslow.

missables.name: Shard of Alexander (Iron Fist Alexander)
missables.lockedBy: Killing Alexander, or not finishing his questline.

missables.name: Rotten Winged Sword Insignia (Millicent)
missables.lockedBy: Not helping Millicent against her sisters at Elphael.
